Swiss Army Bench 0.0.20: drivers that run anywhere, relationship sets, the project's outline, your system's file dialogs, and one footer everywhere.

- **SQL Server and Azure SQL on mssql-python, Dataverse's SQL endpoint on python-tds:** no ODBC driver to install, so
  the same connection runs on an Azure Function App or a hosted Streamlit app. A SQL Server connection saved
  earlier keeps working and its card offers **Update to the new driver** (your own hand-written code is never
  rewritten).
- **"Only works on your machine":** anything that only this computer has (an ODBC driver, Windows sign-in, signing
  in as you, the keyring, a file on this disk) says so in amber on the form, the card, the starters and both
  exports, with what to use instead. New connections start with a sign-in that works on a Function App.
- **Relationship sets** (tangs are gone): the Relationships window lets you tick rows, select all, Delete selected,
  turn joins on and off, change their kind in place, filter, sort and group, each with Undo, and it fits the window.
  Removing a connection removes the relationships it brought in.
- **The ERD shows the tables your project uses**, with a switch to show them all and a count of the hidden ones.
- **Export outline:** ARCHITECTURE.md at the top of your project, the same eight sections every time (overview,
  data sources, data model, transformations, lineage, deliverables, running it with a Function App checklist, open
  issues), with diagrams. Names and types only: never a row, a value or a secret.
- **Your system's own file dialogs** for every Open, Save and folder choice, and a much better picker in the page
  where none can open (places, recent folders, a clickable path, filter, New folder, the keys).
- **A new query can run on a connection:** the "+" tab's **from** picks Grids (your open tables) or any connection
  (its own SQL), or adds one.
- **One footer on every page**, and the rail's Data is now the **Data Catalog** (Insert into a Workbench cell now
  shows even when you open a table quickly).

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.20), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
